notes.GLP1-002-UC-001:
URGENT CARE — 09/15/2024

40 y/o M with 10 days of nasal congestion, purulent drainage, maxillary pressure worse bending forward; initially improving then worse over past 3 days. Low-grade temp 100.1 at home.
Exam: T 99.8. Maxillary tenderness bilaterally, purulent drainage in posterior pharynx, TMs clear, lungs clear.
Dx: acute bacterial rhinosinusitis (double worsening).
Rx: amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg BID x 7 days, saline irrigation, fluticasone nasal spray. Return if fever > 102, facial swelling, vision change, or not improving in 72 h.

notes.GLP1-002-UC-002:
URGENT CARE — 08/14/2025

41 y/o M with 4 days of nasal congestion, sore throat, dry cough, fatigue. Child at home with similar symptoms. No fever, no SOB. COVID home test negative x2.
Exam: afebrile, mild pharyngeal erythema without exudate, clear rhinorrhea, TMs normal, lungs clear to auscultation, no lymphadenopathy.
Dx: viral URI. Supportive care: fluids, rest, honey/tea for cough, saline spray, acetaminophen PRN. Expect 7–10 day course. Return if fever, dyspnea, or symptoms > 10 days.

notes.GLP1-002-PCP-001:
PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 01/11/2026

S: 42 y/o M here to address weight; says his cholesterol results and his clothes both "got his attention." Eats out for lunch most days, drinks 2–3 regular sodas daily. Little regular activity. Taking atorvastatin daily without muscle aches.

O: Wt 96.0 kg, Ht 165 cm, BMI 35.3. BP 118/71.
Exam unremarkable.

A/P:
1. Obesity — patient motivated to start a lifestyle plan today.
 - Mediterranean-style reduced-calorie eating, target about 1600 kcal/day, cut out sugar-sweetened drinks.
 - Brisk walking with a coworker during lunch, 4 days a week.
 - Referred to the clinic's Healthy Weight lifestyle program (RD visits + group sessions). Follow-up here in ~3 months.
2. Hyperlipidemia on atorvastatin 20 mg daily; last LDL 154. Continue; repeat lipids in 6 months.
3. Eczema — stable with PRN triamcinolone.

notes.GLP1-002-PCP-003:
PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/11/2026

S: Weight follow-up. Continues the diet and exercise plan and has kept up with the Healthy Weight program visits since January. Still packing lunch, still walking at lunch, no regular soda. Frustrated: weight 92.8 kg today vs 96.0 kg in January when the plan began (-3.3%), and it has not budged since late spring. Asks whether medication is an option. No hx pancreatitis, no personal/family hx MTC or MEN2.

O: Wt 92.8 kg, BMI 34.1. BP 117/67, HR 70.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 34.1 — plateau despite adherence. Start semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly (Wegovy) with standard titration starting at 0.25 mg. Discussed GI side effects, small meals, hydration; call for severe abdominal pain or vomiting. Continue lifestyle plan. Recheck in 3 months.
2. Hyperlipidemia on atorvastatin 20 mg daily; last LDL 154. Fasting lipid panel ordered.
